content.bridge_context: We transition from simple movements to the scientific concept of 'Energy'—the ability to do work.

units.title: Forms of Energy
units.explanation: Energy exists in many forms like heat, light, sound, electrical, and mechanical energy.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the form of energy. / ऊर्जा के रूप की पहचान करें।

units.title: Energy Conversion
units.explanation: Energy can change from one form to another, like electrical energy to light in a bulb.
units.dual_language_instruction: Trace the energy change. / ऊर्जा परिवर्तन का पता लगाएं।
